sentences.text: The dataset records federal contributions totalling $37M to Canada World Youth between fiscal 1997 and fiscal 2020.
Records show contributions originated under the international youth internship and the Canada Service Corps program lines.
The CRA charity registry records Canada World Youth's status as revoked, with revocation date 2023-08-12.
The final T3010 filing reports the organization wound up its operations during fiscal 2022.
Most recent Global Affairs DRRs for fiscal 2021–22 and 2022–23 do not list Canada World Youth as a current implementing partner.

unverifiable.rationale: Final program-level performance data was not located in either the open contributions dataset or the most recent Departmental Results Reports of the awarding departments.
The T3010 wind-up filing does not reproduce a full asset disposition schedule in the open extract; the CRA charity registry shows revocation but does not reproduce the wind-up financials.
